args.body: Thank you for your email. Two points noted: (1) the dog flap: our inspection report does record a dog flap fitted in the back door/utility room. We are asking the tenant whether permission was given and will report back. Whether to ask for it to be removed or to approve it is your decision, and we will not take any action on it until we hear from you. (2) The spare front door key after the lock change: we are asking the tenant when the lock was changed and who holds the spare key, and will update you. We do not hold a record of the change at present. The report also notes minor sticker marks in Bedroom 1 for the tenant to make good. Could you also confirm the sender of your latest email, as it was signed Felix Clarke rather than Oliver Bennett? We will update you by 2024-02-21.
